summary.text: Trevor Squirrell is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-3 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served on the House Appropriations Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.

paragraphs.text: Trevor Squirrell assumed office in the Vermont House in 2017 and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
In his first session he served on the Natural Resources, Fish, and Wildlife Committee, and he was its ranking member in 2019-2020.

In 2021-2022 he was vice chair of the Legislative Committee on Administrative Rules and served on the Justice Oversight and House Appropriations committees; in 2023-2024 he chaired the administrative rules committee while remaining on those two.
